founder_steps: Google Cloud Console → APIs & Services → Credentials → OAuth 2.0 Client (Infinity OS Communications)
OAuth consent screen → ensure test users or production status allows founder mailbox
Generate new authorization code via OAuth Playground or internal consent URL using the SAME client id (offline access, force prompt if needed)
Exchange code for refresh token; update GMAIL_OAUTH_REFRESH_TOKEN on Vercel project infinity-runtime (Production + Preview)
Run: node scripts/gmail-oauth-health-check.mjs (local with updated .env.local or after Vercel env sync)
Do not paste client secret, auth code, refresh token, or access token into chat or commits
